doc: The value predicate sets `where` replaced, frozen from the assets of ad4b52da, each with where it now sits (an array element is named by its `id` where it has one). Read by every_value_where_lowers_as_the_set_it_replaced.

all.doc: A synthetic aggregate is reported under a parenthesised name; a tool anyone can call begins like an identifier.
No member lacks a `text`: the list is content parts throughout, not a value that happens to start with one.
The conversation, where this carrier has one.
A conversation under its other name - CrewAI-through-LangGraph writes `messages`. Claiming a carrier that has one would take the turn away, which `crewai/error` already proved for `context`.

Smolagents writes its rendered `Calling tools` and `Observation` bookkeeping back into the next model request under these pseudo-roles. The structured model output and TOOL span are the lossless call and result; retaining these renderings as user turns duplicates both and invents a role.

any.doc: This dialect writes a message class path as an array. Asked of every member, not the first: a list may open with a shape that omits it.

A Chat Completions request body, which the OpenAI instrumentor serialises whole and flattens message by message. Its system turn sits inside the list, so the list is indexed exactly as the family is. A request whose system prompt sits beside the list (Converse, Messages) would shift every position by one, which is why a role list alone is not enough.
A generation's message carries its class path as an array.

all.doc: Smolagents' rendered `Calling tools` and `Observation` bookkeeping, as the indexed family's reading excludes it: the model's call and the TOOL span are the lossless copies.
The agent's memory re-sends a step whose model output was empty as an assistant turn with one blank text part; it says nothing.
Exactly a text member. A structured output that happens to have a `text` field beside others is the producer's data, and reading it as prose would lose the rest.
A part holding an inline_data member, readable or not, is an inline part; its file_data is not consulted.
Selects every member when the flag is true, and nothing otherwise.
At least one text chunk: a chunk list with none holds no reasoning here, and the block is read from its other members.
Chat Completions' file part holds the same members under `file`. A `file` block without that object is another dialect's, and is left to it.

No block type at all. The retired reader also reached this case for a type that is not a *string*, which is one predicate this vocabulary cannot spell - so such a block is left to the rest of the chain instead of being claimed as text. The safe direction, and no producer of this dialect writes a non-string type; pinned as a test rather than left to be discovered.
